svg.text: Dotnet · D29 · Actual rows beat a prettier estimated shape
What to read in a plan
Operators, estimates, access path, then numbers.
scan vs seek is not a moral
A scan is not automatically wrong.
Do not index because EXPLAIN said Scan.
Real params → actual plan → one change → measure.
Cardinality lie, then stats, then a hash join.
Duration and reads, not plan cosmetics.

text.tspan: Treat every scan as the problem
